title: Aluna/o pós graduação em Óptica Quântica Experimental
description:
Company Description

The Brazilian Center for Physics Research (CBPF) is a leading national research institute dedicated to advancing theoretical and experimental physics in Brazil. Located in Rio de Janeiro, CBPF conducts cutting‑edge research across various fields including high‑energy physics, cosmology, condensed‑matter, and quantum information. As a unit of the Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation, the center plays a vital role in training the next generation of physicists through its graduate programs and fosters scientific collaboration both nationally and internationally. CBPF is committed to excellence in research, education, and the development of Brazil's scientific infrastructure.

The supervisor and the group

Dr. Carmem Maia Gilardoni is a young permanent researcher at CBPF, where she leads research on quantum‑optical interactions in materials and the engineering of symmetries at the nanoscale for quantum applications. Deeply committed to the personal and professional development of students, Dr. Gilardoni creates a supportive and collaborative research environment that fosters scientific excellence and individual growth. She is also dedicated to advancing diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) initiatives in science, working to create opportunities for underrepresented groups in physics. Dr. Gilardoni holds a PhD from the University of Groningen, awarded the prestigious 2022 Ehrenfest‑Afanassjewa Thesis Prize by the Dutch Physics Council. She has received multiple international recognitions, including the 2022 New Journal of Physics Early Career Award and an honorable mention for the 2022 L’Oréal‑UNESCO For Women In Science Rising Talent Prize. Her previous experience includes a postdoctoral position at the University of Cambridge’s Cavendish Laboratory, where she investigated atomic defects and excitons in 2D materials.

Role Description

This is a full‑time on‑site role for a *Aluno/a pós graduação em Óptica Quântica* at Centro Brasileiro de Pesquisas Físicas - CBPF, located in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. The candidate will be responsible for conducting advanced research in Quantum Optics, participating in collaborative projects, presenting findings at academic conferences, and publishing research papers in scientific journals. Additional tasks include assisting in the preparation of research proposals and mentoring undergraduate students.

Qualifications

  • Knowledge in Quantum Optics and Quantum Mechanics (Preferred)
  • Experience in conducting scientific research and data analysis (Preferred)
  • Proficiency in scientific programming languages such as Python, MATLAB, or similar for simulations (Necessary)
  • Ability to publish research findings in scientific journals (Preferred)
  • Strong problem‑solving and analytical skills (Necessary)
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills (Necessary)
  • A Bachelor's degree in Physics or a related field is required; enrollment in a Ph.D. program is preferred (Necessary)
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a diverse and inclusive environment (Necessary)

Seniority Level

Internship

Employment Type

Full‑time

description:
About Us

Airswift is the leading workforce solutions provider to the STEM industries. For over 40 years Airswift has been transforming lives through the provision of international workforce solutions to STEM industries. Today, we are an integrated team of over 900 employees across 37 countries, supporting over 8,000 contractors globally. We are a people business – we transform lives through the world of work. We care about wellbeing, community engagement and our planet – we plant a tree for every person placed in a job globally. We have a passion for growth, including investing in the development of our people. We support professionals looking for jobs with exceptional firms in the technology, construction, and engineering sectors.

It is a hybrid schedule (3 days at the office per week) in Rio de Janeiro - Cinelândia.

Role Description

The Billing Analyst will have responsibility for specific client accounts in Airswift's sales ledger covering the North American region. You will join a strong team based in our Rio de Janeiro office and will be tasked with ensuring fully compliant and timely billing for clients under your remit.

Principle Accountabilities

  • Assure billing for the assigned client portfolio.
  • Adhere to client billing requirements as per contracts and work orders, call off orders, purchase orders, etc.
  • Liaise closely with consultants on new clients and new client billing requirements.
  • Ensure accuracy and completeness of billing, including recharges to clients.
  • Ensure timely delivery of invoices to clients along with a variety of supporting documentation.
  • Ensure reporting to the Supervisor of any un-invoiced, missed, or incorrect amounts that are not billed timely or become aged.
  • Ensure timely response to clients (external and internal) and report to the direct Supervisor of specific customer requests for timely delivery.
  • Report on funded invoices to the billing supervisor accurately and in a timely fashion.
  • Deliver pro forma invoicing, pre-approvals, SES, etc.
  • Ensure all banking information is correct on invoices as per funded or non-funded category, currency, and billing entity.
  • Follow up on invoices emailed to clients or via consultants to confirm receipt.
  • Reconcile client VMS with an internal invoicing system to ensure invoices are correctly submitted.
  • Monitor the status of invoices that were previously sent by email, portal, or VMS systems for any rejections that require correction.
  • Ensure intercompany invoices are issued correctly and in a timely manner between Airswift's legal entities.
  • Work to month-end deadlines.
  • Compare invoices from Tempest (payroll and billing system) to invoices generated in Amalto to ensure all relevant information has been saved in SharePoint and maintained in line with auditing requirements.
  • Import invoices to Dynamics 365 (financial ERP system), and balance payroll and billing Tempest to D365, ensuring all billing has been captured.
  • Complete submittal logs in a timely fashion and attend weekly submittal meetings with the Billing Supervisor.
  • Ensure all invoices and backups are filed in a shared drive and maintained.
  • Complete queries in a 48-hour turnaround (outside of main invoicing schedules) and maintain and complete query log.
  • Liaise with payroll to validate any payroll adjustments affected by credit notes and complete credit note logs for auditing purposes.
  • Review new client contracts with the Billing Supervisor to ensure all requirements are captured.
  • Ensure Bullhorn (client management system) data is correct and highlight errors to consultants and service teams accordingly.
  • Meet accuracy targets in line with KPIS.
  • Purchase order and work order analysis.
  • Maintain and deliver 3rd party reconciliations and advise the billing supervisor of details to pay – this is working with credit control to ascertain paid invoices (pay when paid basis).
  • Communicate with various parties of the PO analysis ceilings to ensure timely delivery of either renewed PO value or extended PO.
  • Support function for MIDE region invoicing as and when required.
  • Be fully involved in working with credit control to reduce DSO and improve the liquidity of Airswift for the North American region.
  • Follow company policies and procedures, guidelines, and standards.
  • Ad hoc duties as and when required.

Skills, Knowledge, and Experience

  • Fluent English.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
  • 1+ years of experience in a finance function (billing experience preferred, but not required).
  • Knowledge of multi-currency transactions.
  • Knowledge of VAT and WHT is beneficial.
  • Strong attention to detail.
  • Good communication skills.
  • Ability to work in a challenging environment with the ability to meet deadlines and adapt to changing priorities.
  • Experience in liaising with various internal departments.
  • Focused and dedicated mindset.
  • Good team player with the ability to drive changes and improvements.
  • Knowledge of funding and non-funding.
  • Knowledge of withholding tax (training provided).

What we can offer you!

  • Attractive monthly base salary + competitive commission/performance bonus.
  • Genuine career progression opportunities, either locally or globally!
  • World-class training programmes and development opportunities.
  • Virtual Onboarding Events exclusively for new hires.
  • Team driven environment, supportive culture with a focus on work-life balance.
  • Career breaks available after one year.
  • Real time recognition through our employee reward platform.
  • Mental Health First Aiders to signpost you to support when you need it.
  • Yearly destination trips as part of our High Flyers program (Dubai, Buenos Aires, etc…)
  • Charity days for various important causes such as Relay for Life and Earth Day.

Our Core Values

  • Growth - In life and business, one must grow to flourish and achieve high ambitions. Growth requires change, challenge, risk and sacrifice - we will always choose growth.
  • Life – Above all else, we value life. The quality of life, both in and outside of work, profoundly influences our well-being and our impact on the world.
  • Excellence - We deliver, holding ourselves accountable for results. Our customers see excellence in everything we do.
  • Integrity - We are ethical, open, honest and authentic. People trust us to do the right thing for the right reason.

title: Senior Instructional Designer
description:
Be among the first 25 applicants.

We are seeking a seasoned Senior Instructional Designer to lead the design, development, and delivery of innovative e-learning and blended learning solutions in Brazil. In this role, you will combine hands‑on instructional design with leadership and project management responsibilities, guiding a team of designers, developers, and external partners while ensuring the delivery of high‑quality learning experiences and adherence to our global development framework. Fluency in both Brazilian Portuguese and English is essential.

This is a newly formed role and part of our expansion in Brazil. The successful candidate will bring an entrepreneurial mindset, helping to shape the function and drive local growth, while collaborating closely with our established global teams. You will benefit from clear frameworks and support but also have the opportunity to influence and innovate within our learning design approach.

This is a full‑time position based in our training centre in Rio.

Instructional Design

  • Analyse learning needs to scope and design engaging and effective e‑learning solutions.
  • Develop learning objectives, storyboards and assessments for both e‑learning and blended learning products that are aligned with adult learning principles and comply with industry standards.
  • Apply instructional design models and learning methodologies to create engaging e‑learning experiences that align with Maersk Training’s standards, style guides, processes, procedures and templates.

Team Leadership

  • Lead, mentor, and coach a team of instructional designers and e‑learning developers.
  • Assign and oversee tasks, providing guidance and constructive feedback to ensure quality and consistency of products.
  • Foster a collaborative, innovative, and high‑performance team culture.
  • Conduct performance reviews and support team members’ professional development.

Project Management

  • Manage multiple e‑learning projects end‑to‑end, ensuring delivery on scope, quality, timeline and budget.
  • Develop and maintain project plans, schedules, and resource allocation.
  • Work closely with the existing Digital Content Team and L&D Managers in the development of learning products.
  • Serve as the main point of contact for stakeholders, SMEs, and clients, ensuring clear communication and alignment of expectations.
  • Monitor project risks, dependencies, and quality assurance processes.
  • Drive continuous improvement in instructional design processes and project management practices.
  • Balance competing priorities and maintain high standards in a dynamic, fast‑paced environment.

Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in instructional design/e‑learning development, including 3–4 years in team leadership or project management.
  • Proven success managing cross‑functional teams and complex e‑learning projects.
  • Exceptional communication, stakeholder management, and organisational skills.
  • Fluency in both Brazilian Portuguese and English, with the ability to adapt learning and communication styles to ensure training is relevant and accessible to both local and international audiences.

Maersk is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we embrace different styles of thinking. Maersk is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applicants without regard to race, colour, gender, sex, age, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, marital status, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy or parental leave, veteran status, gender identity, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with all legal requirements.

title: Analista de Suporte Funcional
description:
Estamos em busca de um Analista de Suporte Funcional para atuar como ponte entre os usuários do sistema e a equipe técnica, garantindo o correto funcionamento e evolução das soluções oferecidas. O profissional será responsável por receber, analisar e qualificar chamados, diagnosticar problemas de uso, propor soluções, documentar requisitos e apoiar a implementação de melhorias nos sistemas.

Responsabilidades

Análise e Resolução de Problemas

  • Receber, analisar e qualificar chamados de suporte relacionados a funcionalidades do software.
  • Diagnosticar problemas de uso e identificar se a questão é funcional, de procedimento ou sistêmica.
  • Prover soluções e orientações assertivas aos usuários e clientes para a correta utilização do sistema.
  • Colaborar com a equipe de desenvolvimento para a correção de bugs ou implementação de melhorias.

Gestão de Requisitos e Melhorias

  • Coletar, documentar e analisar requisitos funcionais de novos projetos ou de aprimoramentos em sistemas existentes.
  • Propor melhorias contínuas nas funcionalidades do software com base no feedback de usuários e análise de dados.
  • Atuar na validação funcional de novas entregas e versões do software.

Comunicação e Treinamento

  • Manter uma comunicação clara e eficaz com clientes, entendendo suas dores e traduzindo-as em linguagem técnica para as equipes internas.
  • Elaborar documentações, manuais e materiais de treinamento para usuários.
  • Conduzir sessões de treinamento e workshops para garantir a correta adoção das funcionalidades do software.
  • Participar ativamente de fases de testes de software, contribuindo com a visão funcional e de usuário.
  • Apoiar a equipe de projetos na implementação de novas funcionalidades e na validação pós‑implantação.
  • Monitorar e acompanhar a performance das soluções implementadas, identificando oportunidades de otimização.

Análise de Dados e Procedimentos

  • Realizar análises em banco de dados para investigar inconsistências de dados ou de procedimentos operacionais.
  • Contribuir para a definição e otimização de procedimentos operacionais internos e externos relacionados ao uso do software.
  • Identificar padrões de problemas para propor soluções pró‑ativas.

Requisitos

  • Formação superior completa em Sistemas de Informação, Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência comprovada em suporte funcional ou análise de sistemas em empresas de desenvolvimento de software.
  • Habilidade para analisar e resolver problemas complexos, com forte raciocínio lógico.
  • Excelente comunicação interpessoal e escrita, com capacidade de traduzir termos técnicos para leigos e vice‑versa.
  • Conhecimento em metodologias de desenvolvimento de software (Ágil, Scrum, Kanban).
  • Familiaridade com conceitos de banco de dados (SQL, consultas).
  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma colaborativa em equipe e com múltiplas partes interessadas.
  • Proatividade, organização e atenção aos detalhes.
  • Experiência com sistemas de gestão de licitações, e‑procurement ou ERPs.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de gestão de chamados (Zendesk, Jira Service Desk, etc.).
  • Certificações em metodologias ágeis ou ITIL.
  • Plano de Saúde: Coparticipação | Amil. (conferir condições)
  • Plano Odontológico: Coparticipação | Amil.

title: Medical Specialist
description:
Role

Generative AI Associate Analyst (LLM Training – Medical Domain)
Location: Remote
Employment Type: Flexible Contract – Part‑time (up to 25 hours weekly)

About the Role

We are seeking highly qualified professionals with a Master’s or PhD in Medical Microbiology (or related biomedical discipline) to support the development of state‑of‑the‑art Large Language Models (LLMs). As a Rater / AI Trainer, you will play a critical role in shaping how AI understands and communicates complex biomedical knowledge, with a specific focus on microbiological sciences. Your feedback and annotations will inform the improvement of AI systems used in healthcare education, diagnostics support, public health communication, and biomedical research.

Key Responsibilities

  • Critically assess AI‑generated responses in topics including microbial taxonomy, infectious disease mechanisms, host–pathogen interactions, diagnostic microbiology, antimicrobial resistance, and laboratory methodologies.
  • Apply structured annotation to texts, including labelling for scientific correctness, terminology accuracy, logical structure, and clinical relevance.
  • Categorize model outputs using domain‑specific taxonomies (e.g., pathogen type, disease process, diagnostic method).
  • Create real‑world clinical or laboratory scenarios with researchers to design and test prompts that assess the model’s reasoning and adaptability to professional contexts (e.g., interpreting culture reports, recommending diagnostic tests, understanding resistance profiles).

Required Qualifications

  • Master’s or PhD in Medical Microbiology, Immunology, or a closely related biomedical discipline.
  • Demonstrated expertise in core areas such as microbial pathogenesis, clinical diagnostics, virology, bacteriology, parasitology, and immunology.
  • Familiarity with laboratory procedures, microbiological instrumentation, and interpretation of diagnostic test results (e.g., blood cultures, PCR, AST).
  • Excellent written communication skills and fluency in English. Completion of an English language assessment is required.

At Zyte, we eat data for breakfast and you can eat your breakfast anywhere and work for Zyte. Zyte is seeking an experienced Team Lead to manage our Core & MLOps Squad, responsible for "Building the bedrock infrastructure that powers Zyte at scale." The position requires expertise across MLOps, systems programming, and orchestration to lead a cross‑functional team in designing and maintaining the scalable foundation that enables all Zyte teams to build and run their services with confidence.

Responsibilities

Technical Leadership

  • Design and evolve the core platform (Kubernetes, Mesos, GPU scheduling/autoscaling, distributed compute).
  • Own the model platform: registry, experiment tracking, training orchestration, evaluation, serving, and monitoring.
  • Build the Golden Path: reference repositories, a scaffold CLI, opinionated CI/CD pipelines, runtime contracts (health, metrics, tracing, SLOs), high‑performance clients, circuit breakers and other production‑ready defaults.

MLOps Excellence

  • Operate a secure, multi‑tenant model registry and training platform with standardized experiment/evaluation harnesses.
  • Provide turnkey serving patterns (online + batch), drift/quality monitoring, and rollback playbooks.
  • Integrate public/open‑source AI capabilities as managed platform services with cost and data‑governance guardrails.

Team Management

  • Run the squad: roadmap, prioritization, delivery, mentoring, and high engineering standards.
  • Partner with product engineering (Zyte API, Scrapy Cloud), Prod Ops, and Security on adoption and rollout plans.
  • Mentor the team and foster a platform‑thinking mindset.

Ownership Areas

  • Container orchestration (Kubernetes/Knative), GPU provisioning & autoscaling, environment & secret management.
  • Operators, sidecars, and internal SDKs/libraries (Go, Rust, Python, Java) that enforce the golden path contract.
  • Model platform: registry, experiment tracking, training orchestration, evaluation framework, serving infra, model monitoring.
  • Observability: logging, metrics, tracing pipelines.
  • Billing pipeline: metering, events, cost tracking abstractions.
  • Golden Path: Java, Python, ML templates + CI/CD blueprints + docs + scaffold CLI.
  • Reliability enablement (SRE practices), cost governance, supply‑chain security (SBOM, image signing).

Qualifications

Required

  • 5+ years experience building distributed systems; 3+ years in MLOps/ML platform engineering (or equivalent impact).
  • Knowledge of Linux/OS internals (process model, cgroups/namespaces), networking (TCP/IP, HTTP/2), concurrency, and performance profiling.
  • Deep understanding of Kubernetes (bonus: Mesos).
  • Proficiency developing high‑performance services in Java, Rust, Go or C++ (bonus: familiarity with vert.x and Netty frameworks); strong Python skills.
  • Experience with GPU infrastructure (scheduling, containerization, optimization).
  • Track record of designing and operating model platforms (registry, training, serving, monitoring) in production.
  • Demonstrated success leading technical teams and implementing organization‑wide platform solutions.

Preferred

  • Streaming & workflows: Kafka + Argo/Temporal/Airflow or equivalents.
  • eBPF‑based observability, perf tooling, or io_uring experience.
  • Cost optimization for ML/AI; multi‑tenant quotas and fairness.
  • Hands‑on experience authoring Golden Paths (service chassis/templates, CI/CD blueprints, CLI scaffolds).
  • SRE practices (SLIs/SLOs, incident management).

Benefits

  • Have the freedom and flexibility to work from wherever you do your best work, as we are a completely remote company.

A companhia detém e opera 100% do Campo de Baúna , localizado ao sul da Bacia de Santos, que compreende os reservatórios de Baúna, Piracaba e Patola. A companhia também detém os campos de Neon e Goiá , e o bloco S-M-1537, todos ao sul da Bacia de Santos .

No Golfo da América , a companhia tem uma participação não-operacional de 30% nos campos de petróleo e gás Who Dat e Dome Patrol, 16% no campo Abilene, assim como variadas participações em infraestrutura na área de exploração na costa da Louisiana (EUA).

Nossa visão é ser uma companhia líder e independente de energia, capaz de se adaptar a um mundo dinâmico de maneira inovadora e empreendedora. Nosso propósito é fornecer energia de forma segura, responsável, criando benefícios duradouros para todos os seus stakeholders.

title: Senior Manager, Campaigns Mainstreaming (Brazil)
description:
Overview

The Brazil Program is a strategic partnership between C40 Cities and the Global Covenant of Mayors (GCoM), funded by Bloomberg Philanthropies, to accelerate the implementation of climate action across Brazilian cities. The program aims to unlock delivery at scale by identifying and preparing high‑impact, finance‑ready urban climate projects while strengthening the institutional frameworks that support long‑term transformation. It combines on‑the‑ground implementation with targeted support to federal and multilevel governance, leveraging Brazil’s growing climate ambition and the opportunity presented by COP30 in Belém.

Over the next two years, the program will engage at least 50 cities, supporting them to move from planning to action through data‑driven project identification, readiness assessments, and capacity‑building. At least 20 priority actions—particularly in sustainable transport and waste—will be prepared for implementation, with a strong focus on financial viability, social inclusion, and emissions impact. These efforts will be complemented by cross‑cutting strategies on climate budgeting, just transition, and strengthened data ecosystems. Working in close coordination with federal actors and national city networks, the program will create the enabling conditions for long‑term, replicable investment in urban climate solutions across Brazil.

Alongside implementation, the program will leverage Brazil’s leadership in global climate diplomacy to elevate city voices, strengthen and establish a model of multilevel coordination for other countries, and integrate local action into the international climate agendas. With COP30 in Belém, the initiative brings visibility to the urban Amazon, supporting practical solutions in cities facing deep socio‑economic and environmental challenges. It will also showcase CHAMP in action, using Brazil’s COP30 Presidency and co‑chair role in the NDC Partnership to promote the inclusion of subnational contributions in NDCs. By advancing Climate Federalism and amplifying mayoral leadership—especially from the Amazon—the program aims to inspire globally just, inclusive, and locally driven climate action.

Scope

The Senior Manager Campaigns Mainstreaming (Brazil) will collaborate with the C40 RME (Regions & Mayoral Engagement) and External Engagement teams. This consultancy will provide strategic leadership on mainstreaming campaigns in support of urban climate action in Brazil, focusing on countering misinformation, addressing awareness gaps, building responsive campaign actions, and strengthening public and local stakeholder support for urban climate solutions that the programme is supporting in implementation.

Role

The role will act as a campaigns consultant and key advisor, offering guidance, strategic input, and best‑practice sharing across cities and work‑streams championing and defending the urban climate policies supported by the program across cities and work‑streams. This includes sharing frameworks for campaign strategy design and delivery, and sharing successful campaign stories from Brazilian cities to the rest of the cities part of the C40 and GCoM networks.

It will help connect city‑level action with national narratives, stakeholders, and local communities—ensuring visibility, alignment, and engagement. The role will also support cities in breaking down internal silos and aligning cross‑departmental functions to design effective, data‑informed campaign and engagement strategies. This includes applying horizon scanning, creative public engagement tools, and cross‑functional collaboration frameworks to unlock strong partnerships and long‑term impact.

Additionally, the role will foster cross‑city collaboration by linking relevant actors, surfacing success stories, identifying opportunities for high‑impact engagement and storytelling. It will contribute to programme‑wide efforts to integrate public engagement strategies into diplomacy, leadership, and advocacy activities—building the momentum needed to advance urban climate goals.

The program is multi‑sectoral. The role will face specific challenges and opportunities on each piece of the work. Illustrative examples of challenges the post should aim to support are related to bus electrification, clean air zones; recycling and organic waste management; the Amazon and deforestation.

You will work closely with the C40 and GCoM External Engagement, RME, Inclusive Climate Action, Advocacy, Comms and CSN teams, in particular the Transport and Waste sectoral teams, at global, regional and city levels.

Responsibilities

  • Political analysis . Become familiar with the program and its flagship projects and identify key pressure points and political opportunities through qualitative (interviews, workshops, etc.) and quantitative (surveys, polling, etc.) analysis.
  • Landscape mapping . Identify political and public opinion emerging trends; valuable city, national or regional partnerships; and key moments to support impactful mayoral action relevant to the program's urban climate policies, and share this knowledge with cities.
  • Leadership . Design and lead on strategic campaign interventions to support the delivering of the programme, in collaboration with city teams, partners, agencies and with the Senior Comms Manager.
  • Strategic input . Offer campaign expertise, strategic input and best‑practice sharing across cities and work‑streams to design and deliver campaign actions to drive forward the urban climate policies supported by the programme.
  • Campaign guidance . Guide cities in breaking down internal silos, aligning cross‑departmental functions and building project plans to design and deliver effective campaign strategies.
  • Rapid response interventions . Act quickly on new opportunities, crises, or threats related to the programme's priority projects and policies. This includes responding to events like extreme climate events or opposition to our work. You'll need to collaborate closely with other teams to make sure our program stays on track.
  • Tools development . Facilitate the exchange of best practices and the development of scalable campaign tools for cities and communities within and beyond the region, such as toolkits, self‑assessment exercises, knowledge products and pre‑bunking resources for use by city staff and mayors who are driving high‑impact actions.
  • Campaign activations . As required, provide bespoke support to identified cities where there is a greater or priority need for deep‑dive support to design and deliver campaign actions.

Required Experience

  • Fluency in English and Brazilian Portuguese.
  • Deep knowledge of the regional, national and local political, institutional and media contexts. Anchored in real‑life problems Brazilian cities face.
  • Significant and demonstrable experience working with local governments to effectively navigate political and public engagement.
  • Successful track record of campaign strategy design and implementation, ideally in the urban climate space.
  • Strong motivation to work in the climate space.
  • Proven track record of consulting and working collaboratively and effectively with major global partners and funders, such as NGOs and advocacy organisations, philanthropic trusts, and the corporate sector.
  • Expertise managing different potential sectorial approaches and subsequent third‑party hiring needs.
  • Comfortable working in matrix environments and remote settings.
  • Committed to equity, diversity and inclusive climate action.
  • Climate, or urban, or urban climate campaigning grassroots experience.
  • Experience with campaigning in any of the following sectors: transport, waste, forestation and/or the agro‑industry.
  • Experience working with national governments and/or international institutional bodies.
  • Familiarity with Brazil’s national climate programs: knowledge of initiatives such as PAC, PCVR, PLANARO, and CHAMP implementation pathways, especially as they relate to city‑level action.
  • Fluent in Spanish.

Other Requirements

Applicants must already have the right to work in the listed locations. Moderate travel will be required as part of the role.

Note: This is a consultancy opportunity; the successful individual will be liable to pay their own taxes, in accordance with relevant legislation in Brazil.

Reporting To

Head of Campaigns, Green Jobs and Green & Healthy Streets

Term

Fixed term until the 31st of May 2027.

Location

Brazil – please note that if your right to work in one of the listed locations is not confirmed at the time of applying, C40 will be unable to proceed with your application.

Salary

Grade 3 (IC) USD 76,745 (gross per annum). Due to its commitment to maintain equity and fairness, C40 operates on a spot salary model. This means that our employees are paid the same salary according to their grade and location.

Application Process

The closing date for applications is Friday, 14th November 2025 at 5pm GMT . C40 reserves the right to close this consultancy opening before the closing date for applications, so please do submit applications (CV and cover letter) early.

To learn more about the work of C40 and our cities, please visit , follow us on Twitter @c40cities and like us on Facebook at .

title: Gerente de Hospedagem
description:
Descrição da função:

O Gerente de Hospedagem é o responsável por dirigir e supervisionar as atividades de recepção, portaria e mensageria, garantindo o bom andamento das operações e a entrega de serviços de excelência. Atua como elo entre a diretoria e as equipes operacionais, assegurando o cumprimento de metas, normas e políticas internas.

Principais atividades:

  • Supervisionar e coordenar as equipes de recepção, mensageria e portaria, garantindo o cumprimento das rotinas operacionais e padrões de atendimento.
  • Acompanhar a taxa de ocupação, reservas e eventos previstos, ajustando a operação conforme a demanda.
  • Realizar a abertura e fechamento das atividades da unidade, assegurando a correta execução dos procedimentos financeiros e administrativos.
  • Analizar relatórios de desempenho e indicadores de performance, propondo ações corretivas e de melhoria contínua.
  • Garantir o cumprimento da legislação hoteleira (FNRH, hospedagem de menores, emissão de notas fiscais, documentação de hóspedes etc.).
  • Controlar contas de hóspedes, acompanhar cobranças e efetuar lançamentos financeiros.
  • Supervisionar o atendimento aos hóspedes, buscando sempre a satisfação e resolução imediata de eventuais reclamações.
  • Manter a comunicação e integração entre os departamentos, repassando informações e alinhando estratégias operacionais.
  • Acompanhar e orientar a equipe, promovendo treinamentos, avaliações e feedbacks periódicos.
  • Zelar pela segurança de hóspedes, colaboradores e patrimônio do hotel, garantindo o cumprimento das normas internas e de segurança do trabalho.
  • Gerenciar o estoque de produtos e materiais do setor, realizando inventários e controlando o consumo.
  • Garantir a ambientação e organização das áreas sociais e operacionais durante o turno noturno.
  • Participar de reuniões e planejamentos estratégicos, contribuindo para o alcance dos resultados da unidade.
  • Cumprir e fazer cumprir as normas, políticas e procedimentos da empresa.
  • Executar outras tarefas compatíveis com a função e orientações da liderança.

Vaga efetiva , com escala 6x1 , tendofoco em cobertura de folgas e apoio operacional aos finais de semana. Oportunidades de crescimento e desenvolvimento contínuo dentro da Rede Riale Hotéis.

Se você é um líder com perfil analítico, proativo e comprometido com a excelência no atendimento , venha fazer parte da Rede Imperial e contribua para manter o alto padrão de hospitalidade que é marca registrada da nossa empresa.

title: Analista de Cobrança
description:
Job type: Full-time employee Full-time employee

Buscamos um(a) Analista em Cobrança com perfil jurídico e experiência em Recuperação Judicial e Falência. Essa posição terá papel estratégico na recuperação de créditos, atuando tanto na cobrança administrativa quanto no suporte inicial às cobranças judiciais, com foco em empresas em situação de estresse financeiro ou em processos de recuperação judicial. O(a) profissional será fundamental para reforçar a segurança jurídica e otimizar os resultados da companhia em cenários complexos de inadimplência.

  • Conduzir negociações de cobrança administrativa com clientes inadimplentes, propondo alternativas seguras (parcelamentos, acordos, garantias).
  • Elaborar notificações extrajudiciais, cartas de cobrança, contratos de confissão de dívida e aditivos com garantias reais ou fidejussórias.
  • Atuar na análise de contratos e identificar riscos jurídicos de clientes em situação de crise financeira.
  • Preparar documentação para habilitação de crédito em processos de Recuperação Judicial, Pré-Recuperação Judicial ou Falência, interagindo com escritórios parceiros e administradores judiciais.
  • Apoiar a área jurídica na estruturação de ações de cobrança, execuções, monitórias e incidentes processuais.
  • Monitorar prazos legais, decisões judiciais e eventos relevantes em processos de clientes estratégicos.
  • Acompanhar indicadores de recuperação e propor estratégias específicas para carteiras em risco de insolvência.
  • Contribuir com melhorias em políticas de crédito e cobrança, alinhadas à legislação e ao contexto do setor de infraestrutura.
  • Formação superior em Direito (OAB ativa);
  • Desejável pós-graduação em Direito Empresarial, Recuperação Judicial ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência em cobrança administrativa e judicial, prefrencialmente em empresas ou escritórios com foco em direito empresarial, contencioso cível e recuperação jurídica/falência;
  • Necessário conhecimento em Direito Civil, Empresarial e Processual Civil;
  • Necessário conhecimento em setruturação de garantias reais e fidejussórias (penhor, alienação fiduciária, cessão de recebíveis);
  • Necessário conhecimento em habilitação e acompanhamento de créditos em processos judiciais;
  • Necessário conhecimento em elaboração de notificações extrajudiciais, contratos de confissão de dívida e instrumentos de cobrança;
  • Desejável conhecimento em sistemas de gestão.
  • Vale Alimentação ou Refeição;
  • Plano de Saúde;
  • Participação nos Lucros.

Somos a Betunel, uma das mais antigas e tradicionais empresas distribuidores de derivados de petróleo do país. Criada em 1967, nossa história confunde-se com o próprio desenvolvimento do mercado de asfalto no Brasil. Contamos com 13 fábricas distribuídas por diferentes cidades brasileiras. Além de nossa extensa atuação na distribuição de asfaltos e óleos combustíveis, atuamos fortemente na produção de ligantes asfálticos modificados e aditivos especiais para Pavimentação. Nossos produtos são desenvolvidos e testados pensando na qualidade, na segurança e no respeito ao meio ambiente. Somos o supplier que cresce junto com o cliente então venha compor o nosso time nos ajudando a criar parcerias bem pavimentadas!

A AVSI Brasil é uma organização da sociedade civil, sem fins lucrativos, criada em 2007, que atua com foco na melhoria das condições de vida de pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade. Trabalha em parceria com atores da cooperação internacional, setor público e iniciativa privada. Vinculada à Fundação AVSI, ONG italiana atuante no Brasil desde os anos 1980, tem como missão promover o protagonismo das pessoas em seu desenvolvimento, de suas famílias e comunidades. Implementa projetos sociais com base em uma metodologia de desenvolvimento integral e solidário, voltada à autonomia e à dignidade humana. title: Join Our Talent Pool - Production Technician
description:
Candidate Pool - Production Technician role at SBM Offshore

Join to apply for the Candidate Pool - Production Technician role at SBM Offshore

Imagine your career taking you to the depths of innovation and the heights of impact. Our people enable continuous progress. Their commitment, collective expertise, and unique capabilities are the engine room behind SBM Offshore’s True. Blue. Transition. – shaping the future of energy, and beyond.

About Us

SBM Offshore is the world’s deepwater ocean‑infrastructure expert. Our work is already resulting in cleaner, more efficient energy production. True. Blue. Transition. is our promise to enable that into the future while at the same time using our expertise to support new and existing markets in the blue economy. It starts with advancing our core – continuing to advance the decarbonization of traditional energy production. While pioneering more: helping to enable the energy transition and using our unique capabilities in ocean infrastructure to support more industries to grow sustainably. Sharing our experience for a better blue tomorrow.

Reports To

  • Production Supervisor

Background

  • The Production Technician is responsible for operating plant process and utility systems effectively and safely, always ensuring strict adherence to procedures. Compliance with GEMS and local regulatory requirements must be maintained in all aspects of work.
  • They are also responsible for executing maintenance and preservation tasks efficiently and safely to ensure the reliability and longevity of equipment. This involves cleaning, housekeeping, blasting, spraying/painting, isolation and reinstatement, greasing application, and preservation of topside flanges and bolts. The technician must keep their supervisor informed of all activities, especially when safety is an issue.
  • They will demonstrate exemplary safety awareness and technical competence in all aspects of maintenance and preservation work on and around the vessel.

Authority

  • The Production Technician is authorized to operate the process and utility systems safely and efficiently and help prepare the plant for maintenance.

Immediate Subordinates

  • Subcontractors, visitors, vendors, external and unplanned or temporary services.

Accountable For: Responsibilities & Standards

  • 1) Process: Start up, operate, monitor, and shut down process and utility systems.
  • 2) Monitor, maintain, and optimize process parameters (level, flow, temperature, pressure, etc.) within operating requirements.

Transformar vidas com saúde é o que nos move! Atuamos em todo o Brasil por meio de duas unidades de negócios, Amil e Rede Total Care, com mais de 1.500 hospitais credenciados e uma rede própria de hospitais, clínicas, centros de tratamento, home care e transporte médico.

Com uma missão clara e valores sólidos, fortalecemos nossa cultura com compromisso de servir sempre melhor. Cuidamos das nossas pessoas colaboradoras para que esse cuidado se reflita na população que atendemos.

Promovemos uma cultura inovadora, diversa, equitativa e inclusiva.

Todas as candidaturas qualificadas são bem-vindas, sem distinção de etnia, raça, deficiência, orientação sexual, identidade ou expressão de gênero, idade, nacionalidade, religião ou qualquer outro marcador social.

Reforçamos que não solicitamos pagamentos, taxas ou códigos SMS em nossos processos seletivos. Todas as oportunidades estão disponíveis em nossos canais oficiais e no nosso site de carreira. Qualquer situação diferente deve ser denunciada.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Realizar avaliação nos aspectos sensório-motores e cognitivos a fim de identificar limitações na funcionalidade e desempenho ocupacional nas atividades de auto cuidado, instrumentais da vida diária e de vida prática registrando os dados no formulário "Avaliação de Terapia Ocupacional" que deve ser impressa, assinada e constar nº do registro profissional;
  • Estabelecer objetivos do tratamento terapêutico ocupacional e data de reavaliação a fim de verificar se os objetivos propostos inicialmente foram alcançados e estabelecer a frequência dos atendimentos;
  • Consultar os registros do prontuário, pelo menos das últimas 24 horas antes de iniciar o atendimento do paciente, para compreender melhor o caso e assim ter condições de prestar uma assistência mais adequada;
  • Registrar no prontuário a evolução, após o atendimento do paciente, a fim de documentar a avaliação diária, conduta realizada, resposta do paciente à terapia, alterações de objetivos do tratamento e programação de novas condutas (se necessário), discussões com a equipe multidisciplinar e orientações fornecidas aos pacientes e seus familiares. A qualidade do registro em prontuário irá contribuir para garantir o acesso às informações do paciente e a continuidade do cuidado;
  • Indicar e orientar o uso de equipamento adaptativo e / ou tecnologia assistiva, a fim de facilitar o ganho funcional do paciente, incremento da independência e ganho de qualidade de vida;
  • Orientar e indicar adaptação de órtese bem como mudanças do estilo de vida, com orientação para manejo do tempo e conservação de energia;
  • Verificar a necessidade e escolher apropriadamente os recursos terapêuticos que serão utilizados para o atendimento ao paciente, preferencialmente antes do iniciar o atendimento, com intuito de antecipar as demandas visando prestar uma assistência completa;
  • Monitorar constantemente todos os pacientes em acompanhamento da terapia ocupacional observando a evolução clínica e necessidade de intervenções, a fim de planejar melhor a assistência ao paciente;
  • Orientar pacientes e familiares quanto ao tratamento proposto e seus objetivos durante a internação e na alta, com consequente, orientação domiciliar;
  • Preencher a estatística de pacientes atendidos diariamente com objetivo de controle do número atendimentos realizados;
  • Conversar com familiares, pelo menos uma vez ao dia, a fim de explicar os objetivos do acompanhamento da terapia ocupacional e dar oportunidade para esclarecimento de dúvidas;
  • Seguir normas e rotinas estabelecidas pelo SCIH (Serviço de Controle de Infecções Hospitalar), consultando os documentos disponíveis no sistema GED (Gerenciador de Documentos) e participando dos treinamentos, com o intuito de aplicar as ações e contribuir para a prevenção de infecções hospitalares;
  • Prestar assistência nas unidades de internação quando houver necessidade da Instituição (por exemplo, diminuição do nº de pacientes que precisam da assistência de fisioterapia na UTI);
  • Consultar e-mail corporativo diariamente;
  • Informar a supervisão a respeito de queixas de pacientes/familiares ou problemas gerais;
  • Executar atividades relacionadas aos processos da área, conforme designado pelos líderes imediatos ou de acordo com a necessidade da área;
  • Cumprir e respeitar as normas e regras instituídas pela empresa, bem como as regras dos órgãos certificadores adotados por esta instituição.

Qualificações Necessárias

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Terapia Ocupacional;
  • Conselho de Classe e Anuidade 2025 em dia;
  • Vivência anterior de pelo menos 1 ano em ambiente hospitalar ou ambulatorial, de acordo com o setor de trabalho;
  • Conhecimento intermediário do idioma Inglês;
  • Pacote Office: Word, Excel, Power Point, Outlook, básico ou intermediário;
  • Cursos de aprimoramento ou atualização nas áreas assistenciais;
  • Desejável curso de Suporte Básico de Vida (BLS) ou similar;
  • Disponibilidade para atuar de Segunda à Sexta de 8 às 14 na região de Duque de Caxias.
